newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers traded fully steady.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was fair. Sales confirmed on 1,500 slaughter steers and 1,500 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 69,200 head confirmed including 12,600 head or about 18 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00; pen select with end choice 1170 lbs 67.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 950-1125 lbs 68.00, pen select with end choice 1150 lbs 67.00.
week to date: 69200 last week: 90500 last year: 59300
